beats.say: 36.7 million streams: Shakira's track hits a milestone tenth week at number one on the Billboard Global Excl U S chart.
According to Billboard, the Burna Boy collaboration also tops the Global 200 for a seventh week.
Yet Billboard notes that same week the song sold only 4,000 copies worldwide.
The gap shows how modern platforms drive massive chart success across the globe today.
Work out the ratio: for every single copy sold, over 9,000 people streamed it online.
Digital plays now decide the world's biggest track, making physical sales practically obsolete.
What does this huge shift mean for future releases? Which chart metric matters most to you?

facts: Shakira and Burna Boy's Dai Dai nets a milestone tenth week at number one on the Billboard Global Excl U S chart.
Dai Dai tops the Billboard Global 200 chart for a seventh week.
Dai Dai drew 36.7 million streams and sold 4,000 worldwide Aug 21 to 27.
